Definition: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
BiblicalUsage: Hayah is the verb to be, to become, to come to pass, and it is the most used word in the whole Bible. In Genesis 1:3 God says let there be light, and there was light, in Genesis 2:7 man became a living soul, in Exodus 3:14 God names himself I AM THAT I AM, and in Exodus 3:12 he promises Moses, Certainly I will be with thee.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this is the word the whole Bible stands on: God is, and because he is, everything else can become. He does not merely exist, he is with me, and that is the promise I hold when I am afraid.
